XML.Name: hivestack
XML.Description:
Local-first AI agent platform with a per-provider on/off gate, Web UI, and Tesla M40 (Maxwell) GPU support.
Features - Local-first: runs fully offline; every outside provider (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/...) ships with its own enable switch - Web UI: dashboard, chat, agents, workflows, boards, memory, skills, studio, comms, AIOps, governance, economy, settings - Single container: API + UI; persistent /config /data /models volumes - M40-ready: CC 5.2 (Ollama/llama.cpp, driver branch 580)
Parameters: set a strong admin password and (optionally) the GPU UUID.
XML.Overview: hivestack ships the Web UI, API, and offline AIOps loop in one container. Mount /config, /data, and /models for persistence; attach the M40 for local inference via the optional Ollama sidecar.
